name: ERTH 2010
title: Earth History and Global Change
description: Reconstruction of earth history from geological data. Processes and events responsible for the stratigraphic record, and techniques used to decipher it.  An integrated survey of earth history. One or more weekend field trips may be required. Formerly offered as ERTH 3010.
requirement_description: ERTH 1050 or both ERTH 1052 and one of ERTH 1010 or 1051 or 1055 or 1070 or GEOG 1070.
